existing_system_path: POST /control-panel/v1/tasks -> PostgreSQL durable admission -> bounded task queue worker -> deterministic Airflow dispatch/runtime reconciliation
implemented_boundaries: Task create and confirm bodies are bounded before FastAPI JSON materialization by request count, aggregate bytes, per-body bytes, and chunk count.
Existing task APIs preserve response identifiers while durable direct dispatch is a queue-owned acknowledgement rather than a second execution path.
PostgreSQL admission atomically reserves canonical UTF-8 depth and bytes, preserves accepted-key replay, and retains bounded idempotency tombstones after history compaction.
Lease owner, epoch, deadline, deterministic effect identity, submitting state, and commit state are fenced around external Airflow mutation.
Worker-loss retries consume scoped retry budget with deterministic backoff and jitter; ambiguous submitted effects remain outcome_unknown until evidence-backed reconciliation.
Runtime polling uses a fair bounded database schedule; queue, task entity, effect, and rollback mirror terminal state are reconciled by the worker.
CPU scaling excludes GPU and runtime-pending backlog; downstream CPU outstanding is bounded and GPU outstanding is globally fixed at one.
Worker and executor process-tree RSS is portable through psutil, RSS slope is enforced, consumers are supervised, and executor lifetime is bound to exact parent process identity.
Durable-to-legacy ownership cutover fails closed on active or stranded work, and PostgreSQL-to-JSON rollback parity is machine-checkable.
Terminal history is compacted into bounded rollups while accepted idempotency replay remains valid for the frozen retention window.
